name: Antigravity CLI (agy)
install: curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash && if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(node -v | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v)" -lt 22 ]; then curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs; fi && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-context && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-usage && if [ -d "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/context-mode" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-plugin-context-mode" ]; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin uninstall antigravity-plugin-context-mode || true; rm -rf "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/antigravity-plugin-context-mode_context-mode"; fi && { ( [ -x /usr/local/lib/jangada/ensure-chop.sh ] && /usr/local/lib/jangada/ensure-chop.sh; [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/chop" ] && [ -f /usr/local/lib/jangada/agy-chop-hook.mjs ] && node /usr/local/lib/jangada/agy-chop-hook.mjs --register ) || true; }

description.pt: Agente do Google, sucessor do Gemini CLI.
description.en: Google's agent, successor to Gemini CLI.

note.pt: Entre com a conta Google; na primeira vez, o chat abre o terminal para colar o código.
note.en: Sign in with your Google account; the first time, the chat opens the terminal for you to paste the code.
